pair_contract.pair_loss_plan_from_root: 32 TRAIN changed pairs per update supply32 original+32 controlled rows, plus32 regular knownVE rows for each YCB domain; SYNTH64 and PALLOX64. Four-source equal BCE +.25 mean softplus(-(z_original-z_controlled)); pair mapping never selected from VAL/current.

selection.population: VAL, same four sources, native-valid known exact V/E only
selection.criterion: Unweighted mean binary NLL within each source, then equal mean over four sources. Every100 updates; earliest strict minimum; fixed2000 update budget. This conditional selector is different from all-class quality gates.
selection.threshold: pV>=.5 fixed; no radius/threshold/crop/architecture/weight selection from VAL/current
selection.ORIGINAL_YCB_caveat: No known E in ORIGINAL_YCB; VE-only precision is trivially1 when V is predicted. Do not use it as the quality precision gate.
